name: Auryn
source:
With a sharp wit and ever sharper tongue, the young prince feels no disdain for being cast aside for the throne as he gets to pursue life on his own terms, away from the drama of his family.

Though the two of you have never seen eye-to-eye, will the two of you finally find common ground?

[From [url=https://lunamakaio.itch.io/leatherbound]itch.io[/url]]
